description: The floating hero card of the transaction-detail screen: a type pill (INCOME/EXPENSE), the signed amount in h1, and a category chip. Only card on the screen that floats and uses h1. Supports a ghosted 'pending' variant for unsettled bank transactions.

type.description: 'income' | 'expense'. Drives caret icon, word, and sign color.

category.description: Category display name; falls back to 'Uncategorized' (rendered neutral).

categoryColor.description: Category tint hex for the icon chip (used at 12% opacity). Neutral pricetag-outline when absent.

categoryIcon.description: Ionicons glyph for the category chip; defaults to 'pricetag-outline'.

isPending.description: Bank transaction not yet settled → dashed border, ~ prefix, PENDING pill, 70% amount opacity.

typography.amount: typography.h1 + amountColor (70% opacity when isPending, unless it fails contrast → colors.textMuted)

accessibility.label: {isPending ? 'Pending. ' : ''}{typeWord}, {isPending ? 'about ' : ''}{spoken amount}, {category}.
accessibility.colorIndependence: type by caret icon + word + sign prefix; pending by hourglass + PENDING word + ~ prefix; never color alone
accessibility.contrast: pending amount must clear 4.5:1; fall back to colors.textMuted at full opacity if 70% colors.text fails
